How to buy

Purchases are handled on our Discord, in a few quick steps.

  1. Join our Discord and open a ticket.
  2. In the ticket chat, choose your payment method with the help of the bot.
  3. Make the payment and send the receipt in the ticket chat.
  4. Wait for an administrator to arrive and deliver your key.

Important

Always keep your receipt and your key. If you lose either of them, you may lose access to the client or to future support.

Never share your key with anyone: it is locked to your PC.

Faq.

How do I activate my key?

Join our Discord, go to our bot's DMs, and type /Download

What happens when my plan ends?

The launcher tells you the key has expired and stops loading the client. Buy a new key whenever you’re ready to continue. Lifetime keys never expire.

Can I use my key on another PC?

A key binds to the first PC it signs in on. If you change your hardware, contact support and your HWID can be reset.

Which versions are supported?

Currently, Ozark supports two versions: Forge 1.8.9 and Lunar 1.8.9, although a version that supports newer versions of Minecraft is in development.
